jobs.title: Legal Counsel (100%)
jobs.description:
• Legal Advisory: You join a thought-leading in-house legal team that provides high-quality, pragmatic legal advice to all parts of the organization. You devise and implement measures to accelerate delivery of those services.

• Corporate Legal Support: You negotiate and draft agreements across the Climeworks Group and serve as a primary point of contact on a broad range topics such as corporate law, commercial contracts, and compliance.

• Commercial Partnership: You enthusiastically embrace work on a variety of legal and commercial matters to promote attainment of the company’s objectives.

• Legal Operations: You coordinate external legal support and design and implement scalable and cost-effective approaches to legal work.

• Stakeholder Alignment: You will help ensure alignment of the purpose and work of and between your client groups.

Requirements:
• Mission: You are a passionate, mission-driven individual who craves an opportunity to help develop an industry and accelerate the journey to net zero.

• Legal expertise: You are a qualified lawyer with a solid background in corporate law and finance, commercial contracts, and business transactions. Swiss bar admission and/or demonstrated experience in practice areas such as employment law, technology transactions, public policy, or project development and finance will be considered a plus.

• Adaptability: You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, often-shifting, and international work environment.

• Working style & mindset: You are known for an efficient, reliable working style and for your strong financial literacy and business mindset. You are a passionate, mission-driven individual who craves an opportunity to help develop an industry and accelerate the journey to net zero.

• Curiosity: You are curious about technology and enjoy understanding how things work. You are a lifelong learner and do not shy away from exploring new hobbies or areas of interest.

• Continuous improvement: You adhere to a philosophy of continuous improvement and celebrate the successes of your team and those around you.

• Language skills: You have strong business fluency in written and spoken English. German fluency is considered a plus.

Our promise: At Climeworks, you are accepted for who you are, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply – regardless of background, identity, or experience. Studies show that women and individuals from minority backgrounds often only apply for jobs when they meet 100% of the listed criteria. If this sounds like you, don’t hold back. If you think you’d make a great fit for this role, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t check every single box. Let’s tackle one of humankind’s greatest challenges together.

What we offer:

• Time Off: Enjoy 25 paid vacation days every year, plus public holidays.

• Flexibility: Work how it suits you best. We offer a hybrid work setup and up to 4 weeks of remote work annually within any EU country.

• Ownership: Fair base pay paired with an equity package – because your contributions matter.

• Family Support: Inclusive parental leave.

• Continuous Learning: Dedicated budget to invest in your professional growth.

• Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team and earn bonuses for your successful referrals.

Salary: At Climeworks, salary ranges are assigned to a job based on the level of seniority and the location specific market median of similar jobs according to external benchmark surveys. Individual compensation depends on your skills, experience, and the value you bring to the team.

Formalities:

• This position is based in Opfikon, Zurich, and we ask that you work onsite at least three days per week.

• We do not accept candidate profiles through recruitment agencies.

- Adattabilità: Ti trovi a tuo agio in un ambiente di lavoro dal ritmo serrato, spesso mutevole e internazionale.
- Stile di lavoro e mentalità: Ti distingui per uno stile di lavoro efficiente e affidabile, nonché per una solida cultura finanziaria e una mentalità aziendale. Sei una persona appassionata e guidata da una missione, desiderosa di cogliere un'opportunità per contribuire allo sviluppo di un settore e accelerare il percorso verso l'azzeramento delle emissioni nette.
- Curiosità: Ti incuriosisce la tecnologia e ti piace capire come funzionano le cose. Non smetti mai di imparare e non esiti a esplorare nuovi hobby o ambiti di interesse.
- Miglioramento continuo: Aderisci a una filosofia di miglioramento continuo e celebri i successi del tuo team e di chi ti circonda.
- Competenze linguistiche: Hai un'ottima padronanza dell'inglese professionale, sia scritto sia parlato. La padronanza del tedesco sarà considerata un valore aggiunto.

In Climeworks, ti accogliamo per ciò che sei e ci impegniamo a costruire un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni persona si senta valorizzata. Invitiamo tutte le persone qualificate a candidarsi, indipendentemente da background, identità o esperienza. Gli studi dimostrano che le donne e le persone appartenenti a minoranze spesso si candidano per un lavoro solo quando soddisfano il 100% dei criteri elencati. Se ti riconosci in questa situazione, non trattenerti. Se ritieni di essere un'ottima scelta per questo ruolo, ci farebbe piacere sentirti, anche se non soddisfi ogni singolo requisito. Affrontiamo insieme una delle più grandi sfide dell'umanità.

Cosa offriamo:

- Ferie: Goditi 25 giorni di ferie retribuite ogni anno, oltre ai giorni festivi.
- Flessibilità: lavora nel modo più adatto a te. Offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido e fino a 4 settimane di lavoro da remoto all'anno in qualsiasi Paese dell'UE.
- Partecipazione: Una retribuzione base equa abbinata a un pacchetto azionario – perché i tuoi contributi contano.
- Supporto alla famiglia: congedo parentale inclusivo.
- Apprendimento continuo: budget dedicato da investire nella tua crescita professionale.
- Premi per le segnalazioni: aiutaci a far crescere il nostro team e ottieni bonus per le segnalazioni andate a buon fine.

Retribuzione:

In Climeworks, gli intervalli retributivi vengono assegnati a una posizione in base al livello di anzianità e alla mediana di mercato specifica per la sede di posizioni simili, secondo indagini di benchmark esterne. La retribuzione individuale dipende dalle tue competenze, dalla tua esperienza e dal valore che apporti al team.

Formalità:

- Questa posizione ha sede a Opfikon, Zurigo, e chiediamo che tu lavori in presenza almeno tre giorni alla settimana.
- Non accettiamo profili di candidati tramite agenzie di selezione del personale.

L’admission au barreau suisse et/ou une expérience avérée dans des domaines de pratique tels que le droit du travail, les transactions technologiques, les politiques publiques ou le développement et le financement de projets seront considérés comme un atout.
- Adaptabilité : Vous êtes à l’aise dans un environnement de travail dynamique, en constante évolution et international.
- Style de travail et état d’esprit : Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre style de travail efficace et fiable, ainsi que pour votre solide culture financière et votre sens des affaires. Vous êtes une personne passionnée, guidée par une mission, qui aspire à contribuer au développement d’un secteur et à accélérer la transition vers le zéro net.

- Amélioration continue : Vous adhérez à une philosophie d’amélioration continue et célébrez les réussites de votre équipe et des personnes qui vous entourent.
- Compétences linguistiques : Vous maîtrisez parfaitement l’anglais professionnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. La maîtrise de l’allemand est considérée comme un atout.

jobs.description:
• Technical Direction: You define and maintain the technical direction for the Electrical Department. You lead the development of fit-for-purpose EIC specifications, design philosophies, and basis of design for execution Globally. You ensure owner requirements are clearly defined, documented, and communicated to contractors, and validate design assumptions against operability and safety, and ensure compliance with local and regional codes and regulations.

• Contractor management : You review and approve contractor submissions for electrical systems and power distribution, enforce owner requirements, provide technical clarifications, and ensure adherence to schedule, quality, safety, and operability. You set clear expectations for execution methods, field quality controls, and turnover documentation needed for safe operation and maintenance.

• System Reliability & Innovation: You lead initiatives to improve reliability and performance of Electrical systems, troubleshoot issues, and implement preventive measures. You evaluate and introduce emerging technologies such as energy efficiency solutions.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: You act as the primary Electrical interface with process, instrumentation and controls, mechanical, and project management teams to ensure integrated designs. You identify and mitigate Electrical risks during design and operation phases and support project teams with scope, cost, and schedule estimates.

• Team Leadership & Continuous Improvement: You supervise and coach junior team members, provide guidance on technical challenges, and drive lessons-learned sessions to maintain a strong knowledge base and promote continuous improvement. You maintain thorough records of technical decisions, design bases, vendor information, and lessons learned for future operational use.

• Cold-Weather and Constructability: As our next DAC plant could be in a cold or hot weather environment, you incorporate climate conditions into the Electrical design and execution planning (extreme heat, freeze protection, winterization, insulation/heat tracing philosophy, cold start/commissioning constraints). You ensure the design is constructable and able to operate and be maintained through cold or hot conditions, including consideration of temporary works, for instance winter work sequencing, and interface constraints with cold-weather activities.

Requirements:
• Professional Experience: You have a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent and have at least 10 years of experience in process plants various climates as an Electrical Engineer. You have experience leading teams.

• Project Experience: You have hands-on involvement in at least one full-cycle project in the mining, water treatment, oil and gas or other comparable industries, covering all phases from FEED and detailed design to construction, commissioning and start-up; preferably in remote/seasonally constrained execution environments. You have expertise in low and medium voltage electrical systems, industrial instrumentation, and control systems.

• Cold-Weather Industrial Plant Experience : You have hands-on experience working with industrial plants in cold-weather environments (e.g. Canada, Nordic countries, or similar climates) and understand the operational, maintenance, and safety challenges associated with extreme weather conditions.

• Communication & Collaboration: You demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills and can liaise with diverse stakeholders, including third-party vendors in IP-sensitive collaborations.

• Working Style: You are precise, adaptable, and reliable, with a proactive and solution-oriented approach. You are comfortable driving decisions and owning them in the office and under field constraints, including winter productivity and schedule risk. You are highly organized, able to plan and prioritize work for yourself and others, and comfortable working in fast-paced environments.

• Language Skills and Travel : You are fluent in English and ready to travel up to 40% of your time (including extended site presence during peak design, engineering, construction and commissioning periods).
